title: Learning Cross-Domain Media Similarity from Amazon Reviews
abstract: arXiv:2611.22756v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Collaborative filtering is a basic foundation of many recommendation algorithms. It works by analyzing a user's history and then suggesting items similar to those in that history. This method typically relies on user data to compute item similarity, data that is widely available to commercial systems but is usually sparse or inaccessible for independent systems and research, especially across multiple media domains. In this work, we propose a method to generalize similarity information between items using supervised learning. As input to our model, we use semantic and temporal features extracted from Amazon product reviews, which are publicly available. As the training target, we use item (product) co-occurrence in the reviewing history of Amazon customers. We evaluate the quality of the predicted similarities across two media domains: books and movies. Experimental results demonstrate the robustness of our methodology, yielding positive

translated_title: 从亚马逊评论中学习跨域媒体相似性
translated_abstract: 协同过滤是许多推荐算法的基本基础。它通过分析用户的历史记录，然后推荐与该历史中项目相似的项目。这种方法通常依赖用户数据来计算项目相似性，这些数据对商业系统来说是广泛可用的，但对于独立系统和研究来说通常是稀疏的或无法获取的，尤其是在跨多个媒体领域的情况下。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种使用监督学习来泛化项目之间相似性信息的方法。作为模型的输入，我们使用从公开可用的亚马逊产品评论中提取的语义和时间特征。作为训练目标，我们使用亚马逊客户评论历史中项目（产品）的共现情况。我们在两个媒体领域（书籍和电影）上评估了预测相似性的质量。实验结果证明了我们方法的鲁棒性，产生了积极的（效果）。
tldr: 提出一种监督学习方法，利用公开可得的亚马逊产品评论中的语义和时间特征，以客户评论历史中的产品共现作为训练目标，成功学习跨媒体领域（书籍与电影）的项目相似性，摆脱了对稀疏或不可获取用户数据的依赖。
en_tdlr: A supervised learning method that learns cross-domain media similarity (books and movies) using semantic and temporal features from publicly available Amazon product reviews, removing reliance on sparse or inaccessible user data.
